titulo: Three ways to show rough work
caption:
Three ways to show rough work

I used to hide my work until it was polished. Then I started showing it rough.

Early eyes catch problems while they are still cheap to fix, and rough work invites a better kind of comment.

For whoever shows the work before it is ready.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A blue-gray room with a table and an orange book standing on it, and a blue figure that asks can I see? in each of three labeled scenes. The cover-up: a teal figure trembles and says it's nothing. while the blue one narrows its eyes. The apology: a brown figure looks down and says it's not good. The show: an ink-black figure says here. It's rough., the book opens, and the blue one answers with happy eyes. The text stays: three kinds of sharing unfinished work. The last card: Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: A small friction, chosen on purpose.
